summary: Backend fully passing (9/9 pytest tests: health, sync push/pull/merge/validation, AI coach writing+code+empty). Frontend mobile UI tested end-to-end on 390x844: home seeding/search/filter/sort, new-file FAB & sheet, editor autosave (Editing...->Saved), language auto-detect ('Auto: Python' for .py), key-1 inserts {}, undo/redo, find-count 1/N, replace-all, diff view, restore, Check screen offline score + 3 issues for 'i recieve alot of email every day', AI Coach returned score=45 with 5 issues & summary, Settings light theme + persistence after reload, font size +/- , sync push/pull toasts. Found 4 frontend issues worth fixing: (1) autocomplete-bar did not appear after typing 'co' prefix in sample.js, (2) sheet confirm buttons (new-file-sheet-confirm, commit-sheet-confirm) are rendered below the 844px viewport requiring force JS click, (3) editor more-sheet does not close when navigating to /history (ghost overlay), (4) named commit saved as 'Autosave' instead of the entered commit label.

ui_bugs.issue: autocomplete-bar never renders when text ends with a word prefix like 'co' in a JavaScript file. Verified via editor.tsx (sample.js opened, text ends with 'co'). suggestion-console/suggestion-const expected but no [data-testid=autocomplete-bar] in DOM. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/CodeEditor.tsx and /app/frontend/app/editor.tsx:467

new-file-sheet-confirm and commit-sheet-confirm render below the mobile viewport (390x844) and are not reachable with a normal tap (Playwright reports 'Element is outside of the viewport'). Had to use JS .click() to proceed. Likely insets.bottom + sheet content height exceeds screen when keyboard-safe padding is applied. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:189 and /app/frontend/app/editor.tsx:527

When tapping more-history, the editor-more-sheet does not close - it remains visible overlapping the history/diff screen (confirmed in screenshot). setMoreOpen(false) is missing from the more-history onPress handler. Reference: /app/frontend/app/editor.tsx:505

After entering 'v1-initial' into commit-sheet-input and confirming, the resulting version row shows title 'Autosave' instead of the entered label. Either the message is not being persisted or the input value is cleared before save. Reference: /app/frontend/app/editor.tsx:527 and /app/frontend/src/lib/store.tsx (saveVersion flow)

issues: Many icon buttons packed into a 390px header (back, title, undo, redo, find, check, more) - some icons feel cramped; consider overflow menu

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on every render: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Originates from one of the dependencies/components; should migrate to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Investigate autocomplete trigger: on web the TextInput value is set programmatically via .fill(); ensure onSelectionChange/onChangeText fires suggestion computation when text ends with a word prefix regardless of selectionStart derivation.

Fix sheet layout so primary action buttons (new-file-sheet-confirm, commit-sheet-confirm) stay within viewport on 390x844; consider ScrollView inside Sheet or SafeAreaView with KeyboardAvoidingView plus sticky bottom action row.
In editor.tsx more-history onPress, call setMoreOpen(false) before goTo('/history') so the bottom sheet dismisses when leaving the editor.
In commit flow, verify commit-sheet-input value is passed to saveVersion/addVersion and persisted as the version message (not overwritten by autosave).
Replace deprecated pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents to silence the react-native-web warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 23 reads EMERGENT_LLM_KEY at import time which is fine; good use of os.environ[] without default so missing config fails fast.
server.py sync_push correctly validates sync_id (regex, length 6-40 chars, upper-cased) and returns 400 on invalid input - matches spec.
server.py AI coach uses claude-sonnet-5-5; takes 5-15s in testing, response parsing tolerant of markdown fences.
No MongoDB ObjectId leakage - BaseDocument.from_mongo maps _id to id and to_mongo excludes id correctly.
editor.tsx is 600 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; recommend splitting find/replace bar and more-sheet into components.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data created. Backend sync tests used TEST- prefixed sync codes which remain in MongoDB sync_spaces collection (acceptable - no cleanup required for this environment).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public base URL is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://jota-android-editor.preview.emergentagent.com. All endpoints at /api/. AI coach calls take 5-15s; use timeouts >=60s. Editor uses a transparent TextInput overlay - on web always use page.get_by_test_id('editor-text-input').fill() to set text, NOT page.keyboard.type (type events reach the overlay layer but value is not persisted). Several bottom-sheet confirm buttons are off-screen on 390x844 - use await page.evaluate("() => document.querySelector('[data-testid=X]').click()") as fallback.
rca_of_issue: Autocomplete bar missing (HIGH): Likely because suggestions are triggered by onSelectionChange/onKeyPress of the TextInput, but .fill() sets value without emitting the native key/selection events. However user typing on real device should trigger it. To validate, add instrumentation that logs the computed prefix in CodeEditor and verify the suggestion list is actually filtered. Named-commit shows 'Autosave' (HIGH): the version row renders 'Autosave' for versions without a message. Looks like the message from commit-sheet-input is not being read/propagated. Trace addVersion/saveVersion in /app/frontend/src/lib/store.tsx and verify that commit-sheet-confirm's onPress passes the input value and not an empty string.
